caption: The drawing depicts the front of a brick building with a staircase leading up to a wooden doorway. The building has green window shutters, with two sets of windows positioned on the upper and lower levels. Wrought iron railings line the base of the staircase and a lower area in front of the building. The structure is overgrown with cascading wisteria vines, which feature dense clusters of pale purple and bluish flowers along with patches of green foliage, trailing over the walls, windows, railings, and partially obscuring architectural details. The door is rendered in shades of brown, the bricks are a warm reddish hue, and the paved ground in front is a muted beige color. The overall composition features a substantial amount of the floral vines and foliage interacting with the architectural elements.
title: City Garden
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
